reason: app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:21 uses the keyword form `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, so Ember's collectionHelper (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:7997-7998) binds the itemView's `_context` to `_parentView.context` (the AdminGroupController / group) rather than `content`, while exposing the Discourse.User only via the `member` keyword (ember.js:8223-8225). Thus `{{#unless automatic}}` in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 resolves against the group controller and hides the remove link for automatic groups.
